data.name: Ancient Telescope
data.desc: See the top 5 cards of your opponent's Deck. Return the cards to the Deck in the same order.

data.name: Ansatsu
data.desc: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

data.name: Burst Breath
data.desc: Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster; destroy all face-up monsters on the field whose DEF is less than or equal to the ATK the Tributed monster had on the field.

data.name: Card Destruction
data.desc: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws the same number of cards they discarded.

data.name: Castle Walls
data.desc: Increase the DEF of 1 face-up monster on the field by 500 points until the end of this turn.

data.name: Claw Reacher

data.desc: Gifted with the power of dragons, this warrior wields a sword created from a dragon's fang.

data.desc: All monsters on your side of the field are treated as Dragon-Type until the End Phase of this turn.

data.name: Dark Assailant
data.desc: Armed with the Psycho Sword, this sinister assassin rules the bad land.

data.name: Dark Titan of Terror
data.desc: A fiend said to dwell in the world of dreams, it attacks enemies in their sleep.

data.name: De-Spell
data.desc: Target 1 face-up Spell, or 1 Set Spell/Trap, on the field; destroy that target if it is a Spell. (If the target is Set, reveal it.)

data.name: Dian Keto the Cure Master
data.desc: Increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

data.name: Disappear
data.desc: Remove from play 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard.

data.desc: A dragon revived by sorcery. Its breath is highly corrosive.

data.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your hand.

data.desc: Select 1 attacking monster. Gain Life Points equal to its ATK.

data.name: Fairy Meteor Crush
data.desc: If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

data.name: Gift of The Mystical Elf
data.desc: Increase your Life Points by 300 points for each monster on the field.

data.desc: Draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards.

data.desc: A giant white shark with razor-sharp teeth.

data.desc: When your opponent activates "Harpie's Feather Duster": Negate its effect, and if you do, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

data.name: Gyakutenno Megami
data.desc: This fairy uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.

data.name: Invigoration
data.desc: An EARTH monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

data.name: Jar of Greed
data.desc: Draw 1 card.

data.desc: This club-wielding warrior battles to the end and will never surrender.

data.name: Just Desserts
data.desc: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

data.name: Koumori Dragon
data.desc: A vicious, fire-breathing dragon whose wicked flame corrupts the souls of its victims.

data.name: La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp
data.desc: A genie of the lamp that is at the beck and call of its master.

data.name: Last Will
data.desc: If a monster on your side of the field was sent to your Graveyard this turn, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck once during this turn. Then shuffle your Deck.

data.name: Light of Intervention
data.desc: While this card is on the field, Monster Cards cannot be Set or flipped face-down. If a Monster Card would be Set, it must be Normal Summoned in face-up Defense Position.

data.name: Magical Ghost
data.desc: This creature casts a spell of terror and confusion just before attacking its enemies.

data.name: Master & Expert
data.desc: A deadly duo consisting of a beast master and its loyal servant.

data.name: Mysterious Puppeteer
data.desc: Each time you or your opponent Normal Summons or Flip Summons a monster, increase your Life Points by 500 points.

data.name: Mystic Clown
data.desc: Nothing can stop the mad attack of this powerful creature.

data.name: Nobleman of Crossout
data.desc: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.

data.name: Ogre of the Black Shadow
data.desc: An ogre possessed by the powers of the dark. Few can withstand its rapid charge.

data.name: Ookazi
data.desc: Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

data.name: Penguin Soldier
data.desc: FLIP: You can target up to 2 monsters on the field; return those targets to the hand.

data.name: Premature Burial
data.desc: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

data.name: Raigeki Break
data.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

data.name: Reinforcements
data.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

data.name: Reverse Trap
data.desc: Until the End Phase, all effects that add or subtract ATK or DEF are reversed. (Additions now subtract, and subtractions now add, instead. Multiplications and divisions, including halving/doubling, are not affected.)

data.name: Riryoku Field
data.desc: When a Spell Card that targets exactly 1 monster on the field (and no other cards) is activated: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

data.name: Rogue Doll
data.desc: A deadly doll gifted with mystical power, it is particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

data.name: Rude Kaiser
data.desc: With an axe in each hand, this monster delivers heavy damage.

data.name: Ryu-Kishin
data.desc: A very elusive creature that looks like a harmless statue until it attacks.

data.name: Scapegoat
data.desc: Special Summon 4 "Sheep Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

data.name: Shadow Spell
data.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 700 ATK, also it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card.

data.name: Shift
data.desc: When your opponent targets exactly 1 monster you control (and no other cards) for an attack, or with a Spell/Trap effect: Target another monster you control that would be an appropriate target; that attack/Spell/Trap now targets the new target.

data.name: Soul Exchange
data.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that target, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

data.name: Sword of Dark Destruction
data.desc: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK and loses 200 DEF.

data.name: Swordstalker
data.desc: A monster formed by the vengeful souls of those who passed away in battle.

data.name: The Eye of Truth
data.desc: Your opponent must keep their hand revealed. Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase, if they have a Spell(s) in their hand: They gain 1000 LP if they have a Spell(s) in their hand at resolution.

data.name: The Flute of Summoning Dragon
data.desc: Special Summon up to 2 Dragon monsters from your hand. "Lord of D." must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

data.name: The Inexperienced Spy
data.desc: Select and see 1 card in your opponent's hand.

data.name: The Wicked Worm Beast
data.desc: This face-up card on the field is returned to the owner's hand during the End Phase of your turn.

data.name: Toon Alligator
data.desc: An alligator monster straight from the cartoons.

data.name: Trap Master
data.desc: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Spell Card, return it to its original position.

data.name: Ultimate Offering
data.desc: During your Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase: You can pay 500 Life Points; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster.

data.name: Unknown Warrior of Fiend
data.desc: The speed of this warrior creates an intense vacuum that can slice through a monster's hide.

data.name: Waboku
data.desc: You take no battle damage from your opponent's monsters this turn. Your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

data.name: White Dragon Ritual
data.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Paladin of White Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 4 or more.
